hooks.command: [ "$CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE" = "true" ] || exit 0; cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && cmake -S . -B build -G Ninja -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release > /dev/null && cmake --build build > /dev/null && echo '==> PadelSim compilado em build/ (rode: ctest --test-dir build)' || echo '==> PadelSim NÃO compilou: rode o cmake à mão e leia o erro'
